criteria.justification: The diff uses only `addReview(productId: ID!, rating: Int!, body: String)` and Review fields `id`, `rating`, `body`, `product`, `author`, avoiding all the listed fabrications (no `reviewText`/`title`, no rating enum, no update/delete mutations, no invented `reviews` argument).
The operation is `addReview(productId: $productId, rating: $rating, body: $body)`, the exact mutation name.
The mutation is declared with `$productId: ID!` and passes it as the `productId` argument.
`$rating: Int!` is declared and a numeric TS `rating: number` is supplied (e.g. `addReview(first.id, 5, ...)`).
`$body: String` is nullable and the TS parameter is `body?: string`, with the demo handling `review.body ?? "(no comment)"`.
The selection set contains only `id`, `rating`, `body`, `product`, and `author`, all of which are listed Review fields.
The request is routed through the authenticated path with `{ authenticated: true }` and documented as "on behalf of the signed-in customer".
